# Monitor function for GA

```{r}
# Create environment to store populations
pop_env <- new.env()
pop_env$populations <- list()
pop_env$fitness <- list()

# Custom monitor function
monitor_fn <- function(obj) {
  pop_env$populations[[obj@iter]] <- obj@population
  pop_env$fitness[[obj@iter]] <- obj@fitness
  cat("Generation:", obj@iter, "Best fitness:", max(obj@fitness), "\n")
}
```


```{r}
par_fixed <- c(
  "water_type" = 2,
  "theta_view" = 0,
  "theta_sun" = 20,
  "sd" = 1
)

par_inversed = c("chl", "a_g_440", "a_g_s", "bb_p_550", "bb_p_gamma", "h_w", "r_rs_b_saccharina", "r_rs_b_cca", "r_rs_b_gravel")

fitness <- objective_factory(
    model = "am03",
    objective = "log-ll",
    rrs_observed = rrs,
    par_inversed = par_inversed,
    par_fixed = par_fixed
  )

test <- ga(
  "real-valued",
  fitness = fitness,
  lower = c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0),
  upper = c(100, 10, 1, 0.5, 5, 20, 1, 0.15, 1),
  popSize = 100,
  maxiter = 1000,
  seed = 1,
  monitor = monitor_fn
  )

plot(test)
```

```{r}
# Combine final population and fitness
final_pop <- test@population
final_fitness <- test@fitness

# Select top N local optima (e.g. top 20)
top_n <- 20
idx_top <- order(final_fitness, decreasing = TRUE)[1:top_n]
top_params <- final_pop[idx_top, ]
top_scores <- final_fitness[idx_top]
```

```{r}
top_pca <- prcomp(top_params, scale. = TRUE)
plot(
  top_pca$x[, 1:2],
  col = heat.colors(top_n)[rank(-top_scores)],
  pch = 19,
  xlab = "PC1", ylab = "PC2",
  main = "Top Local Minima in Parameter Space"
)
legend("topright", legend = "Better → Warmer colors", fill = heat.colors(top_n), border = NA)

```

par_inversed <- test@solution

names(par_inversed) <- par_inversed_name

iop_unconstrained <- iop_from_oac(
  rrs$wavelength,
  par_inversed
)

r_b_fraction_vec <- par_inversed[grepl("^r_rs_b(?!.*_sd$)", names(par_inversed), perl = TRUE)]

rrs_bottom <- compute_r_rs_b_lmm(
  fractions = r_b_fraction_vec
)

rrs_unconstrained <- forward_am03(
  wavelength = rrs$wavelength,
  iop = iop_unconstrained,
  water_type = 2,
  theta_view = 0,
  theta_sun = 20,
  h_w = par_inversed["h_w"],
  r_b = rrs_bottom
)

sub_par <- par_inversed[1:9]

ply <- plot_ly() %>%
  add_lines(x = rrs$wavelength, y = rrs$rrs_0m, name = "rrs_observed") %>%
  add_lines(x = rrs$wavelength, y = rrs_unconstrained, name = "rrs_retrieved") %>% 
  add_annotations(
    text = ~paste(glue::glue("{names(sub_par)}: {round(sub_par, 3)}"), collapse = "\n"),
    textangle = 0,
    x = 1,
    xshift = 0,
    y = 1,
    yref = "paper",
    xref = "paper",
    xanchor = "top-left",
    yanchor = "top-left",
    showarrow = FALSE,
    font = font
  ) %>%
  layout(
    yaxis = list(
      title = TeX("R_\\text{rs}(0^-) [\\text{sr}^{-1}]")
    ),
    xaxis = list(
      title = TeX("\\text{wavelength} [\\text{nm}]")
    ),
    font = font,
    shapes = list(border),
    legend = list(
      font = list(
        size = 20),
      bgcolor = "rgba(105, 159, 245, 0.0)",#"#FFFFFF",
      xanchor = "top-right",
      yanchor = "top-right",
      x = 0.1,
      y = 1
    )
  ) %>%
  config(mathjax = "cdn", displayModeBar = T)

ply

```{r}
all_pop <- do.call(rbind, pop_env$populations)
all_fit <- unlist(pop_env$fitness)

library(uwot)

umap_coords <- umap(all_pop, scale = TRUE)

ggplot(data = data.frame(X = umap_coords[,1],
                         Y = umap_coords[,2],
                         Fitness = all_fit),
       aes(x = X, y = Y, color = Fitness)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "magma") +
  labs(title = "GA Evolution Landscape (UMAP Projection)",
       x = "UMAP1", y = "UMAP2", color = "Fitness") +
  theme_minimal()
```
